modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qualityes: Quality of life in one mod: food and saturation, what-am-I-looking-at panel, effect timers, armor and tool HUD, dark loading screen and a keyboard map. Every module can be turned off and steps aside for the original mod.
qualityessentials.books.color.hint: With a selection - colors it, without one - the text after the cursor
qualityessentials.books.copy_book.hint: Every page, with a --- line between them. With Shift - plain text
qualityessentials.books.copy_page.hint: With colors. With Shift - plain text
qualityessentials.books.delete.hint: Deletes this page. Ctrl+Z brings it back
qualityessentials.books.import.empty.hin: Press Save in a book or put a .txt file into this folder. A --- line in the file starts a new page, &-codes can be turned on in the settings.
qualityessentials.books.import.failed: The file could not be read. It must be UTF-8 and no larger than %s KB.
qualityessentials.books.import.insert.hi: The text goes where the cursor was, the rest moves to new pages
qualityessentials.books.import.replace.h: Every page is replaced with the file. Ctrl+Z in the book brings the old pages back
qualityessentials.books.import.title: Load text into the book
qualityessentials.books.insert.hint: An empty page after this one. Ctrl+Enter breaks the page at the cursor
qualityessentials.books.load.hint: Put text from a file into the book
qualityessentials.books.move_left.hint: Swaps the page with the previous one
qualityessentials.books.move_right.hint: Swaps the page with the next one
qualityessentials.books.notice.cut: A book cannot be longer than %s pages - the end of the text did not fit.
qualityessentials.books.notice.deleted: Page deleted. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
qualityessentials.books.notice.full: The book already has %s pages - that is the limit.
qualityessentials.books.notice.no_room: That does not fit on the page. Remove some text or select less.
qualityessentials.books.notice.save_fail: Could not save the file. Details are in the game log.
qualityessentials.books.paste.hint: Pastes the clipboard at the cursor, long text continues on new pages. A --- line starts a new page
qualityessentials.books.reset.hint: With a selection removes its formatting, without one returns to plain text. Shift - remove all formatting on the page
qualityessentials.chat.long.blocked: Too long: a command can be at most %s characters. Shorten it or turn on Long messages.
qualityessentials.chat.long.parts: %s characters · will be sent as %s messages
qualityessentials.chat.long.too_long: %s of %s characters: this command cannot be split
qualityessentials.chat.restored.separato: Chat from your last visit, until %s
qualityessentials.chat.search.found: Found: %s · Enter jumps to the message · Esc to close
qualityessentials.chat.search.prompt: Type to search · Esc to close
qualityessentials.editor.hint: Drag panels with the mouse. Wheel - size, arrows - nudge (Shift - by 10), Alt - no snapping, Tab - next
qualityessentials.editor.pick: Click a panel to select it
qualityessentials.editor.title: HUD layout
qualityessentials.item_details.hint: Shift: show hidden lines (%s) and details
qualityessentials.keyboard.legend.title: Legend
qualityessentials.keyboard.mouse.title: Mouse
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.conflic: Conflicts: %s. Press Show or click a key on the layout
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.free: This key is free. Press Change on any binding and click this key on the layout.
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.hint: Click a key on the layout to see its bindings and rebind them. Hold Ctrl, Shift or Alt to see that modifier layer.
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.no_conf: No conflicts. Click a key on the layout to see and change its bindings
qualityessentials.keyboard.screen.title: Keyboard map
qualityessentials.keyboard.tooltip.click: Click to see and change bindings
qualityessentials.keyboard.waiting: Press a key or mouse button for "%s". You can click a key on the layout, Esc cancels
qualityessentials.module.books.descripti: A friendlier book editor: colors and styles, insert and reorder pages, long text flows onto the next pages by itself, Ctrl+Z undo, save to a file and load from one. While reading - copy and save the book.
qualityessentials.module.chat.descriptio: Longer chat history that comes back after you rejoin, a wider and taller chat window, timestamps and stacked repeats. Fixes text typed on the wrong keyboard layout: ghbdtn becomes привет, /ызфцт becomes /spawn.
qualityessentials.module.dark_screen.des: Removes the red flash on startup and resource pack reloads: the loading background becomes dark.
qualityessentials.module.effects.descrip: Time left and level right on the effect icons in the corner. The color changes when an effect is about to end.
qualityessentials.module.equipment.descr: Durability of armor and held items, arrows for bow and crossbow, total amount of the held block in the whole inventory.
qualityessentials.module.food.descriptio: Gold frames over the hunger bar show saturation. Food in hand flashes on the bar with what it will restore. Food tooltips show hunger and saturation.
qualityessentials.module.item_details.de: Hold Shift over an item: lines the server hid (enchantments, attributes and more) come back, and a details block shows the id, model, durability, repair cost, rarity, server data and the components the server changed.
qualityessentials.module.keyboard.descri: The whole keyboard with numpad and mouse: bindings on keys, conflicts, Ctrl/Shift/Alt layers and rebinding right on the layout. Default key F10.
qualityessentials.module.look_at.descrip: A panel at the top: the block or creature you aim at, crop growth, redstone power, required tool, breaking progress, health and armor, villager profession, horse speed, source mod.
qualityessentials.module.mount.descripti: Your hunger bar stays on screen while riding, and a panel next to the hotbar shows the mount's health, speed and jump.
qualityessentials.module.new_items.descr: Freshly picked up items get a small star in the inventory. The star goes away once you hover over the item.
qualityessentials.module.screenshots.des: Adds buttons to the screenshot saved message: open the file, open the folder and copy the path.
qualityessentials.module.shulker.descrip: Hold Shift while hovering a shulker box or another container and the tooltip shows its contents as a grid, laid out like the box itself. Look at a placed box and hold Shift to see what it held when you last opened or placed it.
qualityessentials.module.signs.descripti: Copy and paste every sign line at once, click a line with the mouse, Ctrl+Z undo, an &-code palette with a preview. Middle-click a sign to remember its text, and the next sign you place fills itself in.
qualityessentials.module.stats.descripti: An overlay with FPS, ping and TPS. On a server it shows ping and an estimate of server TPS, in singleplayer the real TPS and MSPT of the integrated server.

qualityessentials.option.books.tools.hin: Panel on the right: insert, delete, move a page, copy, save
